about: Retrieval questions over the CRM demo manual (CRM Demo/Help). id = group + variant: 'en' the English original (Q1-Q6 are those of HelpChatAI.LLMBench.pas), 'it' a natural Italian translation, 'para' an English paraphrase that avoids the words of the manual. screen = the screen label, which the engine passes to Search as hint. expected = any of these pages is a hit; empty = not in the manual.

questions.text: How do I move a lead from one column of the board to another, and what happens to its dates?
Come sposto un lead in un'altra colonna della bacheca? E le date cosa diventano?

Can I change a proposal after I saved it?
Posso modificare una proposta dopo averla salvata?

Which export gives me a file I can open in Excel?
Quale esportazione mi dà un file da aprire con Excel?
